newsitems.title: This Week In Destiny - 05/29/2026
newsitems.author: Destiny2_Team
newsitems.contents: [p]This Week in Destiny, we have even more to share about the Monument of Triumph update coming on June 9. We started yesterday with a Dev Insights article focused on the return of the Director, and early this morning we published a Dev Insights article focusing on weapons, the Artifact, and vendors. In this TWID, we'll cover what's coming to the Crucible, Pantheon, and cosmetics.[/p][list][*][p]Crucible tuning with the PvP Strike Team[/p][/*][*][p]Pantheon and Rewards updates in Raids and Dungeons[/p][/*][*][p]Ornaments, Bright Engrams, Bright Dust, and more cosmetics updates[/p][/*][*][p]Have you read yesterday's Dev Insights article about the Director?[/p][/*][*][p]Read this morning's Dev Insights article on weapons and more, too![/p][/*][/list]

newsitems.title: Dev Insights - Weapons, Artifacts, & Focusing Preview

newsitems.title: One of the ideas pitched to save Destiny 2 was reportedly a 'Destiny Infinity' relaunch and a return to the annual expansion model
newsitems.author: Harvey Randall
newsitems.contents: So, Destiny 2 is going the way of the dodo—content updates will end in June, and a Destiny 3 likely isn't even in the cards for Bungie. As someone who has had one of my favourite MMOs shut down before my eyes (and later given an official license to operate on a private server, score) I nonetheless commiserate with you... Read more.

newsitems.title: Modern Warfare 4 Editions: Pre-order Benefits Detailed
newsitems.author: RedBruto
newsitems.contents: [p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45718718/46f4a9dd22524376ef871230f18d6eddcdc9959a.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="jLbst85USN8;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h2]Modern Warfare 4: Pre-order Benefits[/h2][p][b]Warfare Without Limits: [/b][i]Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare®[/i] 4 launches on October 23, 2026. Lock in your preferred edition now to secure a full slate of rewards and bonus content available with digital pre-purchases on PC. See the full breakdown of included benefits in the chart below:[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45718718/6ea1ef82196468198d9b2c5f8c15b9b945a41c14.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][/p][p]Pre-purchases are rolling live for Steam as of today, May 28. Note that it may take some time for pre-order pages to fully cascade across these platforms and by region. Continue to check-in throughout the day if you don't immediately see pages live for your platform of choice.[/p][p] [/p][h3]What are the Available Editions?[/h3][p]There are two editions of [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] to consider for pre-order or pre-purchase:[/p][p]·      [b]Digital:[/b] Vault Edition (all platforms).[/p][p]·      [b]Digital:[/b] Standard Edition (all platforms).[/p][h2] [/h2][h2]Modern Warfare 4: Vault Edition[/h2][p][b] [/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45718718/46f4a9dd22524376ef871230f18d6eddcdc9959a.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]With an incredible selection of premium content, the [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Vault Edition offers exceptional value — especially when combined with the 10% Loyalty Discount† — alongside exclusive rewards available only through this edition. Secure the Vault Edition to gain access to all included content, rewards, and edition-specific benefits:[/p][p]·      [i]Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4[/i] Digital Edition[/p][p]·      Early access to the Open Beta*[/p][p]·      Hunter Killer Operator Skin**[/p][p]·      Hostile Alliance Operator Pack[/p][p]·      Special Forces Operator Pack[/p][p]·      Signature Weapon Collection[/p][p]·      BlackCell (One Season)***[/p][p]·      DMZ Deployment Bonus[/p][p] [/p][p]Want the full details about the Vault Edition Loyalty Discount? Keep reading.[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][h2]What are the Pre-order and Vault Edition Benefits?[/h2][p] [/p][p]Let’s take a closer look at the rewards and bonus content included with your pre-order or pre-purchase, as well as Vault Edition content:[/p][p] [/p][h3]Early Access to the Open Beta*[/h3][p][b][i]Pre-order or Pre-purchase:[/i][/b][i] Digital Standard or Vault  Standard Edition[/i][/p][p][b]Availability:[/b] At the start of the [i]Modern Warfare 4 [/i]Open Beta, later this year.[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45718718/3b36b86b54da444e47687eefaa03e46e6d605de5.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Pre-order any of the two editions of [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] to secure early access to the [b]Open Beta[/b]. Exact Beta timing and availability details will be announced soon.[/p][p][b]Beta Codes: [/b]Players who digitally pre-order [i]Modern Warfare 4 [/i]are automatically granted Early Access to the Open Beta and do not require a Beta Code.[/p][p]Players who do not pre-order [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] should still expect to access the open portion of the Beta.[/p][p][i]* Actual launch date(s), times, and platform availability of MP Beta subject to change. See [/i][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://www.callofduty.com/beta"]www.callofduty.com/beta[/url][/p][p][/p][p][i] for more details. Minimum Open Beta duration is 2 days. Limited time only. Internet connection required. Online multiplayer subscription may be required for MP Beta.[/i][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][h3]Hunter Killer Operator Skin**[/h3][p][b][i]Pre-order or Pre-purchase:[/i][/b][i] Digital Standard or Vault Edition[/i][/p][p]·      [b]Availability:[/b] Instantly in [i]Call of Duty: Black Ops 7[/i] and [i]Call of Duty[/i]: [i]Warzone[/i]™, and at launch in [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i], upon pre-order or pre-purchase.[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45718718/9c3c764b4d156b4d58a6095532325018d4188476.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Pre-order or pre-purchase either of the Digital Editions of [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i], and immediately receive [b]Hunter Killer[/b], a clandestine field operative with a talent for ending engagements.[/p][p]·      Hunter Killer (and the Hunter Killer Skin) instantly becomes available in the Operators Menu of Call of Duty: [i]Black Ops 7[/i] or [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i] next time you access the game.[/p][p] [/p][p]The Hunter Killer Operator Skin will also be available in [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] at launch on October 23. [i](**Call of Duty: Black Ops 7 or Call of Duty: Warzone on your chosen platform is required to redeem. Sold / downloaded separately. Must be redeemed by October 23, 2027.)[/i][/p][p] [/p][h3]Hostile Alliance Operator Pack[/h3][p][b][i]Pre-order, Pre-purchase, or Purchase: [/i][/b][i]Vault Edition[/i][/p][p]·      [b]Availability:[/b] At game launch on October 23.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45718718/381cdc27c05d5a93e83376c2a1b742a07de5ab03.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Unlock the [b]Hostile Alliance Operator Pack[/b], enabling access to the following Operators at launch: Price, Valeria, Ghost, and Blix. Note that Price and Valeria have masked and unmasked variant skins.[/p][p] [/p][h3]Special Forces Operator Pack[/h3][p][b][i]Pre-order, Pre-purchase, or Purchase: [/i][/b][i]Vault Edition[/i][/p][p]·      [b]Availability:[/b] At game launch on October 23.[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45718718/270cac7988aa7cc0181b9d656165f9ed36bc2965.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]An additional Operator Pack is available for those with the [i]Modern Warfare 4 Vault Edition[/i]: Unlock the [b]Special Forces Operator Pack[/b], including four Operators, each with a skin representing their country of origin, each with a voice pack in their local language:[/p][p]·      COM SFT (France)[/p][p]·      KSK Amphibious (Germany)[/p][p]·      South Korean Special Forces (South Korea)[/p][p]·      SAS (United Kingdom)[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][h3]Signature Weapon Collection[/h3][p][b][i]Pre-order, Pre-purchase, or Purchase: [/i][/b][i]Vault Edition[/i][/p][p]·      [b]Availability:[/b] At game launch on October 23.[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45718718/6051653ca2e35214e018fe3058acbd46f159911f.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Own the [i]Modern Warfare 4 Vault Edition[/i] to immediately unlock five different weapons that form the [b]Signature Weapon Collection[/b]. The ranged weapons come with multiple Attachments including an Apex Attachment, all of which are accessible at game launch. Here are the available weapons and Blueprints:[/p][p]·      [b]Kastov 762 Assault Rifle[/b] and [b]“Voltspine”[/b] Blueprint[/p][p]·      [b]ISO Nightshade Submachine Gun[/b] and [b]“La Sombra Venenosa”[/b] (“The Poisonous Shadow”) Blueprint[/p][p]·      [b]Rezi 12 Shotgun[/b] and [b]“Shattered Code”[/b] Blueprint[/p][p]·      [b]Oris 8.6 Marksman Rifle[/b] and [b]“Volt-Edge”[/b] Blueprint[/p][p]·      [b]Combat Knife (Melee) [/b]and [b]“Sombra Besada” [/b](“Shadow’s Kiss”) Blueprint[/p][p] [/p][p]Kastov 762 and “Voltspine” Blueprint[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45718718/cc2b37eccbc62f59b4d8a4025f77a0ca53c76793.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]A full-auto 7.62x39mm rifle offering heavy per-shot impact with equally firm recoil. Reliable and forceful but requires control to keep on target.[/p][p][b]Kastov Arc (Apex Attachment):[/b] An experimental disruption barrel that emits a concentrated high-intensity RF pulse capable of incapacitating infantry, crippling electronics, and destabilizing vehicles caught in its crosshairs.[/p][p] [/p][p]Iso Nightshade and “La Sombra Venenosa” Blueprint[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45718718/212e11ebef3e910063648b72dc6b8199175741e2.jpg"][/img][/p][p]A full-auto 9x19mm SMG with a fast rate of fire, the ISO Nightshade balances controllability, mobility, and close-quarters stopping power into a versatile platform suited for any operator.[/p][p][b]ISO Trace (Apex Attachment):[/b] When hitting a target, Special RFID ammunition transmits a signal back to a built-in optic display on the gun, letting you to track down the victim and finish the job.[/p][p] [/p][p]Rezi 12 and “Shattered Code” Blueprint[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45718718/e0c616f7026fc710550ccdf10ff22cfdfd55d53b.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]A fast-cycling semi-auto 12-gauge, the Rezi 12 delivers powerful, controlled shots with smooth recovery. Built tough and tuned for decisive close-range work.[/p][p][b]Rezi Enforcer (Apex Attachment):[/b] Enables pump-action cycling and is outfitted with a side-saddle for hot-loaded explosive slugs. The added capability extends the platform’s engagement envelope well beyond traditional 12-gauge roles.[/p][p] [/p][p]Oris 8.6 and “Volt-Edge” Blueprint[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45718718/9da9e5bdb7a24024f69a73ad0a91ac2d3978f16b.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]A lightweight bolt-action rifle chambered in 8.6 Blackout, the Oris 8.6 delivers impressive energy from a compact, modular frame. Sleek monolithic design and smooth cycling make it effective for precision fire in tight or mobile engagements.[/p][p][b]Oris Razor (Apex Attachment):[/b] A compact blade module mounted to the receiver, housing up to three quick access throwing knives for close-range, low-signature engagements. Designed as a reliable fallback when stealth or conservation of fire matters most.[/p][p] [/p][p]Combat Knife and “Sombra Besada” Blueprint[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45718718/1cf6a2a43a963f42c73cd312270ba146edec398c.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Lightweight combat blade with a reinforced spine and vented profile for fast, lethal use in close quarters.[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][h3]BlackCell: One Season of Content***[/h3][p][b][i]Pre-order, Pre-purchase, or Purchase: [/i][/b][i]Vault Edition[/i][/p][p]·      [b]Availability: [/b]Access begins with Season 1 (date to be announced).[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45718718/29cdde509b5866addf31d466bbf216876cfa4f18.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Own the [i]Modern Warfare 4 Vault Edition[/i] to unlock [b]a single season of BlackCell access. [/b]Timing determines which season of BlackCell of you receive, with the first opportunity being in Season 1:[/p][p]·      Pre-order, pre-purchase, or purchase the [i]Modern Warfare 4 Vault Edition and play [/i]before or during Season 1 to unlock Season 1 BlackCell.[/p][p]·      Purchase the [i]Modern Warfare 4 Vault Edition [/i]and play after Season 1 to unlock the current BlackCell season.[/p][p]BlackCell includes:[/p][p]·      20 Battle Pass Tier Skips and 1,100 COD Points, instantly unlocked[/p][p]·      Instant access to exclusive content, including a new Operator and Weapon Blueprint.[/p][p]·      BlackCell variants of select Battle Pass content including Operators, Weapon Blueprints, and more.[/p][p]·      Full Battle Pass with 100+ rewards, including weapons, Operator Skins, Blueprints, and COD Points.[/p][p][i](*** BlackCell, Battle Pass, Call of Duty Points and Tier Skips will be accessible in Modern Warfare 4 upon availability of the Season 1 Battle Pass in-game. Redemption applies to one Season of the Modern Warfare 4 Battle Pass only.)[/i][/p][p][i] [/i][/p][h3]DMZ Deployment Bonus[/h3][p][b][i]Pre-order, Pre-purchase, or Purchase: [/i][/b][i]Vault Edition[/i][/p][p]·      [b]Availability:[/b] At game launch on October 23.[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45718718/4e4f89217278f38796cbb0cae4be571e1c820528.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Vault Edition owners can expect additional DMZ content via a Deployment Bonus at launch. Stay tuned for more details on the exact contents of the Deployment Bonus.[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][h2]Vault Edition: [i]Call of Duty[/i] Loyalty Discount†[/h2][p][i]Via digital Pre-order and Pre-purchase on platform storefronts[/i][/p][p]If you’ve digitally or physically owned and played a premium [i]Call of Duty[/i] title dating back to [i]Call of Duty: Modern Warfare[/i] (2019), or have played one of these titles via Game Pass and have an active Game Pass Ultimate, Premium, or PC subscription, expect to digitally [b]preorder the Vault Edition of [i]Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4[/i] with a 10% discount[/b] compared to the  standard MSRP.[/p][p]Here’s how this works:[/p][h2]Qualifying Call of Duty Titles[/h2][p]The discount is available if you own and have played a qualifying previous title, through digital or physical purchase, via an active Game Pass Ultimate, Premium, or PC subscription that has previously played one of these titles, or by claiming the title via PlayStation® Plus Monthly Games. Any edition of the previous title qualifies. Here are the titles:[/p][p]·      [i]Call of Duty: Modern Warfare[/i] (2019)[/p][p]·      [i]Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 Campaign Remastered (2020)[/i][/p][p]·      [i]Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War[/i][/p][p]·      [i]Call of Duty: Vanguard[/i][/p][p]·      [i]Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II[/i] (2022)[/p][p]·      [i]Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III[/i] (2023)[/p][p]·      [i]Call of Duty: Black Ops 6[/i][/p][p]·      [i]Call of Duty: Black Ops 7[/i][/p][h3]Qualifying Platform Eligibility[/h3][p]The discount is only available at checkout if you pre-order or pre-purchase [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] on the same gaming platform and with the same platform account used for the previous qualifying title.[/p][h3]Loyalty Discount: Additional Information[/h3][p]Ensure you claim your Loyalty Discount in time, and note the following intel:[/p][p]·      Expect a 10% discount to the Vault Edition of [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i].[/p][p]·      This discount applies to the [b]Vault Edition of [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] only[/b].[/p][p]·      The discount should appear [b]within the in-game store or platform digital storefront[/b], prior to checkout.[/p][p]·      This discount [b]only applies to pre-orders and pre-purchases[/b]; this offer is valid until October 23, 2026. This offer is subject to change.[/p][p]·      This discount is [b]not available to Vault upgrades[/b]; meaning you cannot pre-order or pre-purchase the Standard Digital Edition and then upgrade to the Vault Edition afterwards and obtain the discount.[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][b]Further Information: [/b]If you require additional support information or guidance regarding the Loyalty Discount, please visit [url="http://support.activision.com/mw4"]Activision Support’s [/url][i][url="http://support.activision.com/mw4"]Modern Warfare 4[/url][/i][url="http://support.activision.com/mw4"] page[/url].[/p][p] [/p][h2]Modern Warfare 4: Digital Standard Editions[/h2][p][b] [/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45718718/4fc5b3f3ff2c35e65cc0e14c0da381646033138d.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In addition to the Vault Edition, you can pre-purchase (on PC) a Digital Standard Edition of [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] on the platforms listed at the start of this Blog. The Digital Standard Edition consists of the full game and the following benefits:[/p][p]·      Open Beta Early Access (Pre-order or Pre-purchase benefit)[/p][p]·      Hunter Killer Operator Skin (Pre-order or Pre-purchase Instant benefit in [i]Black Ops 7[/i] and [i]Call of Duty[/i]: [i]Warzone[/i])[/p][h3] [/h3][h3]Vault Edition Upgrade[/h3][p][i]From Digital Edition to Vault Edition[/i][/p][p]If you pre-order the Digital Standard Edition of [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i], you can upgrade to the Vault Edition at a later date, provided the upgrade is made on the same platform as your original purchase.[/p][p][b]Note: [/b]Upgrade steps may vary by platform. Refer to your platform’s storefront for details.[/p][h3]How Do I Upgrade to the Vault Edition?[/h3][p][b]Steam:[/b] Upgrade via the in-game store or Steam where the Digital Standard Edition was pre-purchased.[/p][p]Additional Notes:[/p][p][b]Price:[/b] The cost to upgrade from a Digital Standard Edition to the Vault Edition is $30 U.S. SRP (or regional equivalent).[/p][p][b]Ineligibility Notes:[/b] The Vault Edition is only available digitally. The Vault Edition Loyalty Discount (see above) is not available if you decide to upgrade.[/p][p] [/p][h2]Stay Frosty: Additional Intel Incoming[/h2][p][b] [/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45718718/73f3eeca662281a3f3d3b18c319c887ca30b36d6.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Track the latest official [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] intel on the Call of Duty Blog as we move toward additional information drops, the [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Open Beta, and launch on October 23.[/p][p][/p][p]Preorders are available now at participating retailers, in-game, on platform stores, or at [/p][p][url="https://CallofDuty.com"]CallofDuty.com[/url][/p][p].[/p][p][/p][p] [/p][h3]Development Credits[/h3][p] [/p][p]Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 development is led by Infinity Ward, and will be available globally on PC via Steam on Friday, October 23rd, 2026.[/p][p] [/p][p]Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 for the PC delivers a fully optimized experience, led by Infinity Ward in partnership with Beenox, for Steam.[/p][p] [/p][p]Additional development by — in alphabetical order — Activision Central Design, Activision Central Technology, Activision QA, Activision Shanghai, Beenox, Demonware, High Moon Studios, Raven Software, Sledgehammer Games, and Treyarch.[/p][p][i]Online multiplayer subscription may be required (sold separately).[/i][/p][p][i] [/i][/p][p][i]On PC, TPM 2.0 and Secure Boot required, other security measures may be enforced. [/i][url="https://support.activision.com/articles/trusted-platform-module-and-secure-boot"]Learn more here[/url].[/p][p][i] [/i][/p][p][i]Content, features, services, online play, and support not available in all regions, and may vary, change, or terminate.[/i][/p][p][i] [/i][/p][p][i]Requires an Activision account and acceptance of the Activision Software License and Services Agreement. A mobile phone number linked to your Activision account may be required to play Modern Warfare 4.[/i][/p][p][i] [/i][/p][p][i]Additional storage space may be required for mandatory game updates.[/i][/p][p][i] [/i][/p][p] [/p][p][i]†Loyalty discount of 10% is based on MSRP.[/i][/p][p][i] [/i][/p][p][i]©/TM/[/i]©[i] 2026 Activision Publishing, Inc.For more information, please visit [/i][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://www.callofduty.com"]www.callofduty.com[/url][/p][p][/p][p][i] and [/i][/p][p][/p][p][i], and follow [url="https://twitter.com/activision"]@Activision[/url] and [url="https://twitter.com/CallofDuty"]@CallofDuty[/url] on X, Instagram, and Facebook. For Call of Duty Updates, follow [url="https://twitter.com/CODUpdates"]@CODUpdates[/url] on X.[/i][/p][p] [/p][p][i]Join [url="http://discord.gg/CallofdutyOfficial"]Call of Duty's Official Discord[/url] to get the latest updates and maybe even meet your next squadmate![/i][/p][p] [/p][p] [/p]

newsitems.title: Announcing Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4
newsitems.author: RedBruto
newsitems.contents: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/4fc5b3f3ff2c35e65cc0e14c0da381646033138d.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]Warfare Without Limits[/h2][p]War erupts on the Korean Peninsula as North Korea launches a full-scale invasion that threatens to destabilize the world in [i]Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® 4[/i]. A young squad of South Korean soldiers fights to survive on the collapsing front lines, while half a world away a vengeful Captain Price wages a personal war from the shadows as he stays one step ahead of those hunting him. As Price’s off-book mission collides with the forces behind the invasion, the war spreads beyond anyone’s control.[/p][p] [/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="jLbst85USN8;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] pushes the series into darker and more dangerous territory, bringing long-running storylines to a powerful and emotional breaking point.[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ef678fcea54e3b6d9b49d59a796313f58f2b262e.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]The Campaign drops players into trench warfare in Korea, close-quarters combat in New York, high-octane chases through Paris, SAS night raids in Mumbai, and city-wide assaults to reclaim occupied territory. Multiplayer delivers grounded, precise combat where fluid movement, player choice, and greater control define every engagement. In DMZ, players operate as an off-the-books asset behind enemy lines, where every deployment into contested territory forces hard choices about which objectives to pursue, what to secure, and when to get out.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/32041265bb850b70661a6811cc8cd99881434f90.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][i]Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4[/i] will launch on October 23, 2026, and be available on PC.[/p][p] [/p][h2]Campaign // Overview[/h2][p] [/p][h3]No Line Holds Forever[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ce26b26546ed4d754d5b436263bad7ac76a8f359.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Fight as Private Park, a young South Korean soldier facing live combat for the first time alongside his squad. What begins as a routine patrol descends into chaos when North Korea launches a full-scale invasion, forcing Park and his unit into a desperate fight through collapsing cities and counteroffensives. The Campaign drops players into the chaos, pressure, and split-second intensity of ground-level combat.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/391866de2f707cd525719e2a875165fd5a150264.jpg"][/img][/p][p]This is a new setting for the franchise, grounded in the military authenticity [i]Modern Warfare[/i] is known for and built with attention to the culture, history, and military detail of the region. The conflict in Korea becomes the catalyst for a broader war.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/4adfa81185a4e2a00f5d1790427ed06409bfe3a3.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Beyond the front lines, operator-turned-outlaw Captain Price works outside the system he once served. A hunt for revenge draws Price toward a weapon powerful enough to shift the balance of power, setting in motion a conflict far greater than he ever anticipated. Forced into uneasy alliances and illicit operations, Price is pulled deeper into consequences he can no longer escape.[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/f602adbc3af72c1f145a11afe104cb81dd6136ee.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/f6dce64be6f317de9c54e18f20d8ae30b7c96f10.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/cc12622d4a8c65bd99ec24f8385eb346ee07319d.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c7ac838ee565ebe6d371da28cc7e43fa407a493f.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/0ac95026d4e80fed5cad0c224938147cad400c36.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c903df79d70e1ba49df745e77d707c88083026f2.jpg"][/img][/p][p]A nightmare scenario unfolds as overzealous leaders, shadow operations, and outside interference push the conflict toward the brink of global catastrophe. From large-scale battles and covert missions to combined-arms warfare and cinematic set pieces, the [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Campaign delivers gritty combat and gameplay variety across a war that spreads far beyond the front lines.[/p][p] [/p][h2]Multiplayer // Overview[/h2][p][i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Multiplayer delivers grounded, precise combat built around fluid movement that provides greater control in every fight. Below are some key innovations to the series:[/p][h3]Ballistic Authority[/h3][p]For [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i], a new weapon-first technology stack unifies precision aiming, physical handling, realistic audio propagation, enhanced visibility, and smarter combat perception into the most authentic [i]Modern Warfare [/i]gunplay yet. Bullet trajectory, weapon motion, Operator stance, camera, audio, FOV, and target visibility all line up in one highly tuned combat fidelity system. The promise is simple: no bloom, no guesswork, and no doubt. Every shot tells the truth.[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/bac70e54847c575b42c8d0f5dde96f976fc6b6e0.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]·      Bloom has been removed, making hipfire shots feel more direct, predictable, and connected to where the weapon is pointed.[/p][p]·      Recoil, convergence, and weapon handling have been rebuilt to more directly reflect player input.[/p][p]·      Depth of field and visual effects have been refined to improve enemy visibility without sacrificing authenticity.[/p][p]·      Weapons respond more naturally to player movement, stance changes, and the environment, creating more consistent behavior in every engagement.[/p][h3]Movement[/h3][p]Movement in [i]Modern Warfare 4 [/i]is built around fluidity, control, and player freedom, delivering fast, grounded combat that keeps Operators responsive through every engagement while expanding how players move, fight, and adapt across the environment. Refined movement systems are designed to support a wide range of playstyles:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/f4bd780d2af496b23faebb1eae17317a52c5c43f.jpg"][/img][/p][p]• Traversal, combat movement, and gunplay transitions are designed to feel seamless and responsive, preserving momentum while maintaining control under pressure.[/p][p]• Expanded movement options for Mantling, Climbing, Hanging and Jumping create new opportunities to reposition, flank, navigate vertical spaces, and approach engagements from multiple angles across increasingly dynamic combat environments.[/p][p]• Every movement system is designed to preserve the grounded realism, physicality, and combat intensity that define [i]Modern Warfare[/i] while delivering the fluid, cinematic intensity of operating as an elite soldier in the field, whether you prefer a methodical, tactical approach or aggressive plays.[/p][h3]Maps[/h3][p][i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] launches with a global set of grounded, visually distinct environments spanning locations around the world, with the 12 Core launch maps — each with a custom infil and distinct visual identity — forming the foundation of a broader Multiplayer offering. In addition, Kill Block, a live-fire training facility built for elite operators, gives players a fresh gameplay experience with every new round. Multiplayer also includes dedicated Gunfight maps and multiple Big War maps built for large-scale vehicles and infantry combat across locations shaped by the Campaign’s global conflict.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/31d4c909b735825e18512bf902df61646a990f30.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Every [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] map is designed to keep combat fast, tactical, and competitive while giving players multiple routes and opportunities to adapt from one engagement to the next.  [/p][h3]Kill Block[/h3][p]Taking place inside the Westbridge Training Facility, Kill Block introduces a dynamic new Multiplayer battleground where the combat space reconfigures between rounds, reshaping sightlines, routes, and cover to keep players adapting in real time. Shaped from a set of purpose-built modular sections capable of creating more than 500 distinct configurations, each match creates its own combat rhythm and tactical challenges. Expect more sections and even more configurations during [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i]’s live seasons.[/p][p]Kill Block supports expanded Gunfight formats, including 3v3 and 10v10 experiences, with future support planned for more core Multiplayer modes. Designed for high-intensity play, Kill Block forces players to think quickly, fight for control, and adjust engagement tactics every round.[/p][p][/p][h3]Progression and Customization[/h3][p][i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] expands player customization while making it faster and easier to get into the action. A redesigned Create-a-Class system unifies Operators, weapons, Equipment, and Killstreaks into a single loadout, giving players quicker access to specialized builds tailored to different tactics and playstyles.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/0cd59c7a91551190f88b01565f9100fe5faa2281.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Gunsmith returns with deeper customization options while remaining approachable for all players, with attachments now shared by weapon class to streamline build creation and experimentation. New to [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i], Gunny brings a Gunnery Sergeant’s eye to weapon customization, helping players quickly assemble effective builds based on their preferred playstyle and unlocked attachments. Featuring configurations developed by Infinity Ward’s Weapons Team, Gunny can instantly configure practical close-, mid-, or long-range weapon builds tailored to different approaches to combat, while still leaving room for further customization and refinement.[/p][p]Progression also expands through Apex Attachments. These are specialized unlocks earned by fully progressing a weapon, introducing unique modifications that can significantly change how that weapon behaves in combat. Depending on the attachment, they can alter handling, firing behavior, tactical utility, stealth capability, or combat role, giving fully leveled weapons new ways to perform beyond standard Gunsmith customization. Alongside new weapons, Equipment, and Killstreaks available at launch, players can also enter Prestige at max Soldier Rank to earn exclusive rewards and continue progressing through additional ranks.[/p][p][i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] introduces greater player choice through two Prestige paths: Classic Prestige and Regular Prestige. Classic Prestige delivers the traditional reset experience, relocking Create-a-Class progression in exchange for increased XP earn rates and access to exclusive Prestige rewards. For players who prefer to maintain their unlocked Loadouts, Regular Prestige allows progression to restart from Level 1 without resetting Create-a-Class content, offering a more flexible path forward while still rewarding continued progression, with its own set of Prestige rewards and progression milestones.[/p][h3]Additional Multiplayer Intel Incoming[/h3][p]Expect a more extensive look at all aspects of [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Multiplayer in the days ahead via the “From the Ward” video series, followed up by a recap blog, including a deep dive into Multiplayer and gameplay systems covering movement and gunplay innovations, maps, modes, progression, and more in greater detail.[/p][p] [/p][h2]DMZ // Overview[/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e8e003f50f3daf651c86df90c03ca8cbadc56de2.jpg"][/img][/p][p]DMZ is the definitive [i]Call of Duty[/i] extraction experience, a living combat arena where every deployment is a new story. Deploy solo or with a squad into a volatile conflict zone as an off-the-books asset tasked with recovering advanced military technology left in the wake of war. The conditions in the exclusion zone are always shifting, with changing weather, dynamic military objectives, and hostile forces moving throughout the zone.[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/a7d215c10ee72b03437fbf8f1d275ec1c068114d.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Loot, fight, negotiate, betray, and extract with whatever you can carry. The harder you push, the harder the world pushes back. Every run is a risk, every encounter is a choice, and no two deployments play out the same way.[/p][h3]Additional DMZ Intel Incoming[/h3][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/73f3eeca662281a3f3d3b18c319c887ca30b36d6.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]You won’t have long to wait for more information on DMZ. Get your first look at DMZ on June 7, including additional details and gameplay-focused coverage.[/p][p] [/p][h2]Technology and Platforms[/h2][p]Every shot. Every moment. Every battle. [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] delivers the most immersive and technically advanced [i]Call of Duty[/i] ever built.[/p][h3]Gameplay-First Visuals at a New Level of Fidelity[/h3][p][i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] delivers a major leap in visual quality built directly into moment-to-moment gameplay and precision-tuned combat. Industry-leading VFX, lighting, materials, and character rendering work together to make combat clearer, more immersive, and more impactful, from explosions, smoke, and atmospherics to character detail and readability in dense, high-action scenes, even on maps filled with lush foliage and teeming with enemy combatants.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/9723dc60eb3c6ba34bc9539ca61a08d588a1c09f.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Fully Optimized for Current-Gen Hardware and High-End PCs[/h3][p][i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] is built natively for current-generation PC, enabling greater scale, density, responsiveness, and consistency across every mode. Players will experience larger combat spaces, more active worlds, clearer engagements, and more consistent moment-to-moment performance. This current-generation focus goes beyond visual fidelity, helping Campaign, Multiplayer, and DMZ feel fluid, more responsive, and built for the full scope of [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i].[/p][p]·      [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] will launch on PC.[/p][p]·      You can digitally preorder Modern Warfare 4 now on PC.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/b066f072f8a36c6f24d76e58410d1c8894386508.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]A Focus on PC[/h3][p][i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] is built with a renewed focus on the PC community, with Infinity Ward and Beenox partnering to give players more ways to tune performance, visual fidelity, responsiveness, and customization on PC.[/p][p]·      PC-specific performance optimizations are designed to support a wide range of hardware, from players prioritizing high frame rates to those pushing maximum visual fidelity.[/p][p]·      Multiple upscaling and frame generation options give PC players more ways to balance image quality, performance, and responsiveness.[/p][p]·      Expanded graphics options give players more control over how the game looks, performs, and feels.[/p][p]·      For players who want to push visual fidelity, high-end PC options include DLSS 4.5 support, expanded real-time ray tracing across Campaign, Multiplayer, and DMZ, improved performance across ray-traced reflections, ambient occlusion, shadows, and volumetrics, and higher-fidelity VFX and volumetric settings.[/p][p]·      Competitive-focused settings help players prioritize high frame rates and responsiveness in the moment-to-moment fight.[/p][p]·      You can digitally prepurchase [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] now on PC via Steam.[/p][p] [/p][h2]Stay Frosty: Additional Intel [p]Hello, PUBG Esports Fans![/p][p]In our previous announcement, we shared the dates and the participating nations for the PUBG Nations Cup 2026 (PNC 2026). Let's take a closer look at PUBG Esports' biggest all-star showdown, where 24 national teams will gather on one stage.[/p][p][b]PUBG Nations Cup 2026[/b][/p][p]PNC 2026 will take place from June 23rd to June 28th in Seoul, Republic of Korea. Across five days of competition, 24 national teams will battle for national pride and a share of the $500,000 base prize pool, further boosted by crowdfunding.[/p][list][*][p]Survival Stage: June 23rd – 24th / PUBG Seongsu[/p][/*][*][p]Grand Finals: June 26th – 28th / Jangchung Arena, Seoul[/p][/*][/list][p]All matches are scheduled to begin at 19:00 KST / 10:00 UTC / 12:00 CEST / 17:00 ICT / 03:00 PDT each day. Further details on ticket sales and on-site events will be shared on the PUBG ESPORTS website in the coming weeks.[/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/659bf6c7733ba6a03e2325102d75d30bf241f851.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Tournament Format[/b][/p][p]PNC 2026 will be played across two stages — the Survival Stage and the Grand Finals — with 5 matches per day.[/p][list][*][p]Survival Stage: 2 days / 10 matches total[/p][/*][*][p]Grand Finals: 3 days / 15 matches total[/p][/*][/list][p]Of the 24 competing teams, the top 8 from PNC 2025 will advance directly to the Grand Finals, while the remaining 16 teams will begin their journey from the Survival Stage.[/p][p][b]\[Grand Finals – 8 Teams][/b][/p][list][*][p]Defending Champion: Vietnam[/p][/*][*][p]Brazil, China, Germany, Indonesia, Korea, Thailand, United States of America[/p][/*][/list][p][b]\[Survival Stage – 16 Teams][/b][/p][list][*][p]Argentina, Australia, Canada, Chinese Taipei, Denmark, Finland, India, Japan, Kazakhstan, Malaysia, Neutral Team, Norway, Philippines, Türkiye, Ukraine, United Kingdom[/p][/*][/list][p]The top 8 teams from the Survival Stage will join the Grand Finals to form a final field of 16 teams. The PNC 2026 champion will be crowned based on cumulative points across the three days of the Grand Finals.[/p][p][b]Tournament Ruleset[/b][/p][list][*][p]Scoring: PUBG Esports S.U.P.E.R Point System[/p][/*][*][p]Maps: Erangel, Miramar, Taego, Rondo[/p][/*][/list][p][b]\[Map Order][/b][/p][p]Survival Stage[/p][list][*][p]Day 1: Erangel → Miramar → Taego → Rondo → Erangel[/p][/*][*][p]Day 2: Miramar → Erangel → Rondo → Taego → Miramar[/p][/*][/list][p]Grand Finals[/p][list][*][p]Day 1: Erangel → Miramar → Taego → Rondo → Erangel[/p][/*][*][p]Day 2: Miramar → Erangel → Rondo → Taego → Miramar[/p][/*][*][p]Day 3: Erangel → Miramar → Taego → Rondo → Erangel[/p][/*][/list][p][b]\[Competitive Settings Update][/b][/p][p]To deliver a more compact and fast-paced match flow, PNC 2026 will be played with adjusted Blue Zone settings.[/p][list][*][p]Shorter early Blue Zone phases: reduced duration for Phases 1 and 2[/p][/*][*][p]Shorter final Blue Zone phase: reduced duration for Phase 9[/p][/*][*][p]Removal of Land Ratio option: Land Ratio option has been disabled for Phases 4 and 8[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted circle size: overall reduction in circle radius to match the shorter match length[/p][/*][/list][p]These adjustments will apply to the PNC 2026 competitive environment and are expected to deliver an even more dynamic and exciting match flow.[/p][p][b]Prize Pool & Crowdfunding[/b][/p][p]PNC 2026 kicks off with a base prize pool of $500,000. 25% of the revenue from the PNC 2026 Event Pass, set to launch alongside the tournament, will be added to the total prize pool through crowdfunding, helping make PNC 2026 an even more rewarding stage for all participating teams.

Further details on the Event Pass, including release schedule and lineup, will be shared in a separate announcement.[/p][p]* The Event Pass is not available on Console.[/p][p]** However, 25% of the individual sales revenue from items included in the Event Pass will be added to the crowdfunding total in the same manner.[/p][p]Stay updated on all things PUBG Nations Cup 2026 by following the PUBG Esports website and our official social channels.[/p][p]
[/p]

newsitems.title: The International 2026 Ticket Sales
newsitems.author: kyled
newsitems.contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3703047/882f6398bbe0c283cb33d57a3c18160c5d5a9f00.png[/img]

In just a few short months, the finest Dota teams in the world will gather in Shanghai to battle for the Aegis of Champions in front of thousands of cheering fans. We've announced [url=https://www.dota2.com/newsentry/655981180194128453]the official team invitations[/url], and now we'd like to extend one to you. If you want to be one of those fans cheering live at the arena, it's time to get ready: ticket sales for The International 2026 kick off on June 10th at 2pm China Standard Time.

The in-arena action runs from August 20 - 23 at the SPD Bank Oriental Sports Center, with two ticket options available: single-day tickets for any day, or two-day bundles covering Thursday/Friday and Saturday/Sunday. All seating this year will be assigned, with no General Admission options available.

Ticket prices vary based on day and section, so check out the full chart of options below:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_LOC_IMAGE}/3703047/eeda1e52cc7d32f4c0db01e2ed4f7ff409a95c4f.png[/img]

There are two purchase paths this year: one for fans purchasing domestically within China, and another for purchasing internationally.

[h2]China Domestic Sales[/h2]
Chinese domestic ticket sales will be available through [url=https://m.damai.cn/shows/item.html?itemId=1052581844801]Damai[/url] or the Perfect World app, and will require a Chinese ID to complete any sale.

Once ticket sales begin on June 10th at 2pm (China Standard Time), the first twenty minutes will serve as a priority purchase period for domestic tickets. During this period, purchases are restricted to active Dota players in China who have played at least ten games in within the last six months. (To be eligible for priority purchase, please [url=https://www.dota2.com.cn/international/2026/ticketspriority]verify your account status[/url] in advance by the end of Wednesday, June 3, 2026.)

From 2:30pm (CST) onward, domestic tickets will be available for purchase to all Chinese customers.

[h2]International Sales[/h2]
For fans purchasing outside of China, ticket sales will commence on June 10th at 2:30pm (CST) via [url=https://www.trip.com/t/TI2026]Trip.com[/url].

[h1]FAQ[/h1]

[b]How does seating work?[/b]
Tickets are purchased for a specific seating region (see chart above). After your purchase, you will be assigned a specific seat in the region you selected. All seats are assigned and reserved. [i]There are no general admission tickets or seats.[/i]

[b]What is the ticket transfer policy?[/b]
Tickets cannot be transferred, gifted, or resold. Tickets can only be used by the names for which they were purchased.

[b]What do I need to purchase tickets internationally?[/b]
Trip.com requires an account and a valid passport for international ticket purchases. You can create your account and submit attendee documentation before tickets go on sale.

[b]Can I purchase tickets for my group?[/b]
Yes, but note that the ticketing platforms limit each individual account to a maximum of two tickets per day. Multiple transactions may be required depending on the size of your group and how many days you wish to attend. As noted above, each attendee/ticket holder must have proper identification in order to complete the checkout process.

[b]Do I need to bring anything else besides my tickets to enter the event?[/b]
Event entrance requires a valid photo ID matching the name on the ticket.

[b]What is the ticket refund policy?[/b]
For China domestic ticket sales, please see the [url=https://m.damai.cn/shows/item.html?itemId=1052581844801]Damai refund policy[/url]. For international ticket sales, please see the [url=https://www.trip.com/t/TI2026]Trip.com refund policy[/url].

newsitems.title: IEM Cologne 2026
newsitems.author: brianlev
newsitems.contents:
The IEM Cologne 2026 Major is fast approaching. Teams are making final adjustments, fine-tuning their strats, and crossing their fingers that they won't face Vitality until the Grand Final. That can only mean one thing: Tournament Items featuring Teams and Player Autographs are now available for purchase!

[h3]The 2026 Cologne Major Shop[/h3]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/3381077/8f7212f18c038fcecaa6c96cfeb9785f14d74489.png[/img]
The Major Shop has undergone some major renovation--now you can directly get any sticker you want (at prices set by demand). Holo Furia logo? You got it. Foil Donk autograph? No problem. 

You can purchase tokens and redeem them for any sticker you want. The prices of stickers will depend on relative demand (when lots of players buy a particular sticker, its price goes up and other sticker prices go down), but if you're worried that a sticker might drop in price right after you buy it, we've got you covered. If a sticker price drops by more than 25 tokens within 24 hours of your purchase you'll get a refund of tokens for the total difference.

Details about the Major Shop renovation and how this all works can be found in the FAQ below.

[h3]Souvenir-O-Matic[/h3]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/3381077/8b98a1ee99bd0178265c42624a4ee8d41ac91768.png[/img]
What will you bring to the signing session? Now you can craft your own Souvenir! Take any normal or Souvenir quality weapon in your inventory and select a completed match and one of the players. You'll get your weapon back in Souvenir quality with gold team, autograph, and map stickers applied.

[h3]Pick'Em[/h3]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/3381077/b50091a00523a82121c1e9707ca7a92276d21349.png[/img]
Purchase and activate a Cologne 2026 Viewer Pass, and you'll receive a 2026 Cologne Major Challenge Coin. Play the Pick'Em Challenge to upgrade your Challenge Coin from Bronze to Silver, Gold, or Diamond and with each upgrade you'll get 300 tokens that you can redeem for the stickers or souvenirs of your choice.

[h3]Supporting the Teams[/h3]
As with previous Majors, 50% of the tournament item sales are shared with the Tournament Organizer, Teams, and Players. But this time the royalty rates depend on performance. Between now and the end of the Major royalty rates for token sales are based on the teams' VRS seeding, and after the Major the royalty rates will be based on the Major final standings. The breakdown is in the FAQ, below.

So clear your schedule and tune in, as the Major returns to the Cathedral of Counter-Strike!

[h2]FAQ[/h2]

[h5]Q. Why aren't you selling capsules?[/h5]
In the past we shipped team and player autograph stickers in capsules. While this approach was popular, we've heard feedback that players might prefer to purchase stickers directly. Additionally, players in certain regions cannot purchase sticker capsules. So we're exploring alternatives that allow all players to participate.

[h5]Q. How do I get tournament items?[/h5]
Add any sticker or stickers you like to your cart, and check out. To complete your transaction, first you'll purchase and activate tokens, and then redeem those tokens for your sticker.

Sticker purchases are final and cannot be refunded. If you cancel your transaction before activating your tokens, those tokens _can_ be refunded. If you cancel your transaction after activating your tokens, the tokens will remain in your balance (and cannot be refunded) but you can redeem them for something else.

[h5]Q. How are sticker prices set?[/h5]
The prices of all stickers depend on relative demand. This means that if one sticker is purchased disproportionately more than another, its price will go up and the other sticker's price will go down. After a large number of stickers are sold, all sticker prices will update (you'll get a warning if you're shopping when this is about to happen). The prices in tokens you see are the same prices for everyone worldwide.

[h5]Q. Why do I have to purchase tokens?[/h5]
Tokens are a little less convenient than just paying for stickers outright. But the reality is that if stickers could be refunded after being purchased, then the sticker prices would not accurately represent real demand.

[h5]Q. Can I pre-purchase tokens?[/h5]
No. Tokens are only purchased when you're buying stickers and do not already have enough tokens in your balance. In that case, you'll be asked to purchase the exact number of tokens required (minimum 100, which is $0.99 USD) to complete your transaction.

[h5]Q. What if the sticker price goes down after I redeem my tokens?[/h5]
If the price of any redeemed sticker decreases by 25 tokens or more within the next 24 hours, we'll automatically issue you a refund of tokens for the difference between your redemption price and the lowest price in that period. Refunds are automatically credited to your tokens balance after one week.

[h5]Q. How do souvenirs work this time?[/h5]
Take any weapon of normal or souvenir quality in your inventory and select a completed match and one of the players from that match. You'll permanently convert that weapon into a Souvenir with gold team, autograph, and map stickers applied. You will have a chance to see a preview of your souvenir before you complete your purchase.

If the weapon had any existing stickers, they will be removed before you craft your souvenir.

[h5]Q. How are souvenir prices determined?[/h5]
Souvenir prices are determined by two factors: the demand for the specific gold team and autograph stickers involved, and the rarity of the weapon you choose for your souvenir.

[h5]Q. How are royalties shared among the tournament organizer, teams and players?[/h5]
50% of total Major Shop and Major Pass revenue is shared as royalties with the tournament organizer, teams, and players. The chart below shows how that 50% is distributed. Note that for each team position, half of the royalties are shared with the team organization, and the other half is split equally among the five players.

Dota 2 esports is in an odd place. Once the premier sphere, it's been overtaken by the mammoth that is League of Legends - a beast that isn't showing any signs of slowing down. While Dota 2 remains huge in the East, its Western appeal has started to falter over the years, partly because it doesn't quite have the same content release cadence as other MOBAs, and partly because there's that big shiny thing called 'Deadlock' in the works. We've seen the legendary OG rip out its roster and start all over again, The International 2025's prize pool capped out at a mere $2,881,791 (for context, in 2021 it was $40,018,195), and now, Heroic has confirmed that it's leaving Dota 2 behind.

Or will their enemies regroup in time for the counterattack?[/p][p] [/p][p]Season 03 Reloaded fans the flames with a firestorm of new content across all modes, including new experiences like Heat Wave Havoc and Hot Pursuit joined by extra maps, game modes, the next Round-Based Zombies Map, and additional Weapons, Blueprints, Operator Skins and more earned across Mid-Season Events and Weekly Challenges. [/p][p][/p][p]Gear up and engage the enemy when the Mid-Season update arrives in [i]Call of Duty®: Black Ops 7[/i] and [i]Call of Duty: Warzone™ [/i]on Thursday, April 30 at 9AM PT.[/p][p][/p][h2][u]Black Ops 7: Season 03 Reloaded Endgame[/u][/h2][p][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][td][p][/p][h2]ENDGAME CONTENT SUMMARY[/h2][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Endgame Free to Play Update: [/b]Endgame remains free to play for a limited time, offering new and returning players the chance to drop into the co-operative PvE experience focused on squad-based runs, boss, encounters, and repeatable challenges.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Operation Broken Mirror:[/b] Operations deepen with the introduction of Act II: Operation Broken Mirror, introducing new challenges, rewards, and the Virus Injection Glitch. By exploiting that breach, JSOC gains a delivery path for Karma’s virus, putting Javelin in position to deploy it from within and collapse the mirror network entirely.[/p][p] [/p][p]Earn new rewards for every completed objective, including powerful upgrades for your Operator that will aid them in future steps.[/p][p] [/p][p]In the final step, gain access to the new Virus Injection Glitch and take on the Glitch Boss. Operation rewards include a new Weapon Blueprint, Emblem, Double XP Token, Restore Token, Loading Screen, and more, detailed below.[/p][p] [/p][p]Note that while Operation Poison Pill started with objectives that needed to be completed in Zone I or higher, Operation Broken Mirror begins with a Zone III or higher requirement right from Step 1, so ensure your Operator is up to the task before starting this Operation![/p][p][/p][h3]Face the Virus Injection Glitch, Earn Rewards[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/3f7060a9b152e60d582ccc3765b902ebaad0c493.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Earn a variety of valuable rewards and get powered up as you progress through the steps. Discover the location of the Virus Injection Glitch and take on waves of enemies and the Glitch Boss in Nightmare Difficulty.[/p][p] [/p][p]Defeat the Virus Injection Glitch Boss in the final step of Operation Broken Mirror with Vermaak, Zaveri, or Jurado to earn the unique “Aftershock” Operator Skin.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Act II Skin Completion Camos:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Earn 1 “Aftershock” Operator Skin to get the “Braincase” Weapon Camo.[/p][/*][*][p]Earn all 3 “Aftershock” Operator Skins to get the “Neon Gallows” Animated Weapon Camo.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Operation Broken Mirror Rewards[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/95d2bf067e195849a682f2a22ee348279c538585.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]·  “Adrenal Drive” Weapon Charm and 1,000 XP[/p][p]·  Restore Token and 1,000 XP[/p][p]·  1 Hour Double Player XP Token and 1,000 XP[/p][p]·  “Meltdown” Emblem and 2,500 XP[/p][p]·  1 Hour Double Battle Pass XP Token and 2,500 XP[/p][p]·  “Toxic Drip” Large Decal and 2,500 XP[/p][p]·  1 Hour Double Weapon XP Token and 5,000 XP[/p][p]·  “Hype Dose” Loading Screen and 5,000 XP[/p][p]·  “Tiny Hello” Emote and 5,000 XP[/p][p]·  “Lethal Injection” Weapon Blueprint, “Virus Injection” Animated Calling Card, and 7,500 XP[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]New Activity: Mega Abomination[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/4ac2a2f32a087f6829066b4e4ecea392e7a10603.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Face a new boss that spawns in Nightmare Zones once the Guild Strike boss for the zone has been conquered! Defeating the Mega Abomination guarantees an Exotic Weapon Case drop, so the encounter should be well worth your time... if you survive.[/p][p] [/p][h3]New Major Ability: Thermal Spike[/h3][p][i]Emit a powerful blast of flames that incinerate enemies. For a cooler experience, play a game of Freeze Tag where it’s your team’s goal to chill the enemy while keeping your allies in the fight.[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][h3]Multiplayer Maps[/h3][p] [/p][p][b]Onsen[/b][/p][p][i]Brand-New, 6v6/2v2, Small-Sized[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/687a4133a039cde3179d471a7886d62f7c681495.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Assault a remote onsen in Yamanashi as a clandestine deal falls apart and fighting erupts. Relax along the pool, terrace, and sauna, or cut enemy foes off at the underpass.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/01e2422671b8ca7db7795b7207d30f918ed91df2.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Summit[/b][/p][p][i]Remastered, 6v6, Medium-Sized[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/7acc09e2c35f4ecb1ab8c6bd2bb7d3b3f51b2f29.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]The iconic Summit returns as players breach a dangerous Russian facility perched atop a snow-covered mountain. This classic mid-sized map was first introduced in the original [i]Black Ops[/i], its three-lane layout funneling Operators into hot zones like the central control room and across the narrow cliffside and catwalk.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/f5e5f8f07cedd7e7ad5282ed6507ea049fe5a788.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]This remastered version offers the most detailed incarnation of Summit to date, with Wall Jumping adding a new twist to the many battles head.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Hacienda[/b][/p][p][i]Returning, 6v6, Medium-Sized[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d3dad7611d27930f68fd33d4cc40d19e0aee8d9d.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Attack a fortified crime family estate as rival forces storm the mansion grounds in Hacienda, a classic mid-sized map centered in and around the grand villa. Gawk at the luxury vehicles in the driveway on your way to the foyer opening onto the estate. Enjoy the art and engage in long fights down the Gallery or stretch your legs out in the vineyard. For a more relaxed experience, stroll through the garden and take a dip in the pond.[/p][p] [/p][p]First seen in 2018, Hacienda fits right into [i]Black Ops 7[/i], bringing both new and classic environments to the Mid-Season map pool.[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][h3]Multiplayer Modes[/h3][p][/p][p][b]Freerun[/b][/p][p][i]New Mode, Launch[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/62f249150098e7f43ec09b9007556b5dd28ed001.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]The Guild is seeking early volunteers for a new Project Synapse training program, providing contestants the opportunity to prove themselves as you race against the clock while overcoming obstacles.[/p][p] [/p][p]Overseen by Dr. Atwood, the Freerun course takes place on the Ascent map, a Guild Tower construct designed specifically for the Freerun mode. When the race begins, follow the track to progress through an increasingly demanding 10 zones, testing your abilities across a variety of challenges. With ten racers per match, you’ll need to keep up your momentum to pull ahead.[/p][p] [/p][p]Freerun Course Rewards:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/2d7d767c783cf50c9bc5278c0922dbe240799e7c.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Complete the Freerun: Ascent course three times to earn the “Scaled” Emblem and 1,000 XP.[/p][/*][*][p]Collect all Ciphers in Freerun: Ascent to earn the “Upswing” Weapon Charm and 2,500 XP.[/p][/*][*][p]Complete the Freerun: Ascent course in under 14 minutes with fewer than 10 faults to earn the “Innovate” Universal Weapon Camo and 5,000 XP.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p]Compete for additional rewards in the Mid-Season Freerun: Ascent Challenge Event—including two additional Weapon Camos—detailed in the Season 03 Reloaded Events section found below in the General Content section of this blog.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Heat Wave Havoc[/b][/p][p][i]New Mode, In-Season[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/11936b622f7b296348e68d9c43a7c70d180fde71.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Get fired up in Heat Wave Havoc, a new LTM that rewards Operators with enhanced abilities for supporting their team with non-lethal cooperative actions. Drop into a Mosh Pit of Team Deathmatch, Kill Confirmed, Domination, and Hardpoint, and see how hot you can get to become a firestorm of destruction.[/p][p] [/p][p]Operators progress through five different Heat Levels, each level granting additional abilities improving combat efficiency. Generate heat through support actions like revealing enemies, scrambling enemy radars, buffing teammates, impairing enemies, capturing and defending objectives, and other non-lethal actions.[/p][p] [/p][p]Support your team to generate heat and gain Operator bonuses based on your Heat Level as follows:[/p][p] [/p][p]·   [b]Low Heat:[/b] Faster Field Upgrade recharge.[/p][p]·   [b]Medium Heat:[/b] Faster movement, sprint-to-fire speed, and mid-air mobility.[/p][p]·   [b]Hot:[/b] Faster weapon reloads, ADS speed, and swap speed.[/p][p]·   [b]Extra Hot:[/b] Equipment refills after eliminating enemies.[/p][p]·   [b]Extra Extra Hot:[/b] Increased damage and score for headshots.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Freeze Tag[/b][/p][p][i]New Mode, In-Season

[/i][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c478e30612864311f26223d3eb58672cc622a07e.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Cool off with a game of Freeze Tag, a new 6v6 respawn mode where teams compete to freeze their enemies while keeping allies thawed and in the fight. Eliminated Operators drop into a frozen state, where they are unable to complete any actions until a teammate shatters them free by shooting or otherwise damaging their downed teammate.[/p][p] [/p][p]If one team manages to freeze the entire enemy team, a Total Freeze will occur, releasing all Operators from their frozen status and awarding the team who froze all enemies a large score boost. Use your mini-map to track the location of frozen teammates, so you can prevent a Total Freeze from being inflicted on your side. The first team to reach the score limit wins.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Black Ops 7: Season 03 Reloaded Zombies[/b][/p][p][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][td][p align="center"][b]ZOMBIES CONTENT SUMMARY[/b][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]New Round-Based Zombies Map — Totenreich: [/b]The crew descends on an old Norwegian fishing village, first founded during the Bronze Age and now caught in the Dark Aether. Explore the unsettling relationship between the locals and the Group 935 research facility established there, investigating nefarious experiments in the wake of giants.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]New Enemies and Wonder Weapon:[/b] Face the dreaded Necropincer, rising from the depths to attack the unwary with its deadly trident and a ferocious mutated claw. Also wield the Jotunn Star, a wide-sweeping melee Wonder Weapon that bathes and burns enemies with spectral energy.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]New Features: [/b]Roast zombies to a crisp with the Flammenfalle Trap, bringing much needed heat to this cold island. Still not hot enough? Try out the new Wild Fire Field Upgrade to pulse waves of fire that burns enemies who get too close. Take on the Main Quest for XP and rewards, test your skills in Cursed, unlock new Pack-a-Punch Camos, and perhaps find a fabled Ultra-Rarity Legacy Weapon within the Mystery Box![/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]New Map: Totenreich[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/a6c766ffd3fa0641a3c2a971dbd1bcada9e0e11f.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][i]“Welcome to Eidskallen – Sorry about the reception committee.”[/i] — The Twins[/p][p] [/p][p]The time loop is broken, and following the Dark Heart’s defeat in Paradox Junction, the Twins transport the crew to a new destination: Eidskallen, a Norse fishing village on a blustery, windswept coast that has been inhabited since the late Bronze Age. Historians have noted that the site has been occupied through the centuries, all the way to the age of Vikings, and into modern times. Indeed, evidence of medieval Norse structures can be found across the island, from burial mounds, a feasting hall, and a strange stave church. All overlooked by an ominous lighthouse, still shining its light into the gloom.[/p][p] [/p][p]The entire settlement has been ripped from reality, casting the Group 935 research base and their hulking mechanical machinations into the Dark Aether.[/p][p] [/p][p][i]“… this place… is mein legacy.”[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Deploy to the frozen birthplace of nuclear fire and explore the ancient village that Group 935 transformed into a research base hiding sinister secrets.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Totenreich: Giants Collide[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/78ff0ac9e86318d6e0e9b641157a880a507f3475.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]As a towering Shadowsmith threatens to crush them underfoot, the crew barely escapes. The gigantic creature is bound to this place, and you must explore the island to get to the bottom of its dark past.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/f817ea231d58bca335433406a78770e423ae4361.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Uncover rickety pathways and use ziplines to cross frozen, icy waters as you navigate the island.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Totenreich: New Enemy: Necropincer[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/fbc973efa537c4389c7dd692a2e902768220a116.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Tales tell of a doomed undead Viking warrior spirit—known to some as a Draugr— challenging invaders to vicious armed combat. It seems the presence and the sheer brutality of Group 935 have awakened an unnatural aberration that rises from the cold seas to aid in the protection of Eidskallen. Said to be summoned by those “followers of the old ways,” these frightening chimeras now attack on sight, perhaps driven mad after further experimentation by Group 935 itself.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d40ad72027a8e4c1e2f27161933a48d06bada6d0.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]The Necropincer wields a trident, piercing and stabbing adversaries who venture too close, while throwing the weapon at more distant foes. With its giant crab claw in place of a left arm, the creature can also block incoming shots and use this pincer to slam and bludgeon. This is an enemy equally prepared for offense and defense. A relentless combatant, the Necropincer exemplifies the cold death awaiting those unable to stand up against its formidable aggression.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Totenreich: New Wonder Weapon: Jotunn Star[/b][/p][p][i]Mastery Badges Available for this Weapon[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/bf6909223af142b1e13c100969e51500f1e136c9.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][i]Forged when Odin ruled the sky and giants walked the land, this ancient lantern casts death-dealing fireballs and strikes down foes with a barbed iron chain. Are you worthy to wield it?[/i][/p][p] [/p][p]This wide-sweeping Melee Wonder Weapon can take on even the most cold-hearted of enemies, stealing their souls for use in generating devastating attacks. A Norse artifact fortunately hidden from Group 935’s covetous hands by those on the island familiar with its myths and “old ways,” the Jotunn Star casts light and deadly fire.[/p][p] [/p][p]With the Jotunn Star in hand, the wielder can attack enemies to inflict major damage. Striking them with up to five attacks in a row unleashes a deadlier hit, releasing an area of spectral energy on impact.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/13d7e4659fde3881c11c87fca5878e55bc270296.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Lantern Swing:[/b] A dexterous wielder can swing the weapon in front of them, using the blunt instrument to drop advancing undead.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Flame Charge:[/b] The Jotunn Star drains the essence of creatures it eliminates, storing the energy within the weapon. This energy can be stored to provide warmth and to enable the Flame Tendril and Flame Strike attacks.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Flame Tendril:[/b] When two or more fully charged lanterns are being utilized, a fiery cord connects them and slowly drains the life of anything that gets in its way[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Flame Strike: [/b]When sufficiently charged, the stored energy within the Jotunn Star can be discharged as a concentrated, explosive fireball, damaging and setting foes alight.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Totenreich: Flammenfalle Trap[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/1e0a7a8767e8c4b1959775fb08813be87d2d82be.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][i]Roast foes with a blast of flames.[/i][/p][p] [/p][p]Drop some Essence to spin up this new trap that shoots out three jets of flame incinerating undead foes in range of the hot blasts. Once you’ve got the power back up and running, this scorching trap is just the ticket if you want to heat up your slaying capabilities.[/p][p] [/p][p]Enhance the Flammenfalle’s abilities by activating a valve on the body of the trap, activating a heat zone that protects the crew from chilling effects, gives weapons the chance to trigger Napalm Burst, and passively builds the Jotunn Star’s Flame Charge while inside of the heat zone.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Totenreich: A Chill in the Air[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/84a64a79b4b7dcd659b0be0936dd41f92cfd10de.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Totenreich: New Main Quest, Quest Rewards, and Challenges[/b][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/b51d7ce710a642ade9ae5ce1c0d6826d4314c849.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]The Main Quest for Totenreich becomes available when the map releases with Season 03 Reloaded on April 30 at 9:00 AM PT. Complete the Main Quest to earn the following:[/p][p] [/p][list][*][p]The “Ambition” Richtofen Operator Skin, Calling Card, and 10,000 XP.[/p][/*][*][p]Complete Totenreich Mastery Challenge for another Calling Card and 5,000 XP.[/p][/*][*][p]Obtain the necessary Intel (Audio Logs, Documents, and Artifacts) to earn a third Calling Card and another 10,000 XP.[/p][/*][*][p]Players who complete the Main Quest before Directed Mode arrives for this map will also earn a unique Calling Card variant.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Totenreich: Cursed Mode, New Pack-a-Punch Camos[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/af4955ef97e697fde6df70279a562f7caeb8138c.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Take on the ultimate challenge with Cursed mode on Totenreich, offering no Main Quest guidance and providing a limited HUD and a starting Pistol. Hunt down new Cursed Relics and earn rewards including the following:[/p][p] [/p][list][*][p]The “Jade Legion” Pack-a-Punch Camo, Calling Card, and 15,000 XP.[/p][/*][*][p]The “Crimson Legion” Pack-a-Punch Camo, Calling Card, and 20,000 XP.[/p][/*][*][p]The “Heliotrope” Pack-a-Punch Camo, Calling Card, and 25,000 XP.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]New Field Upgrade: Wild Fire[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/3f679201f715d215001b435600687e15a70ca742.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][i]Imbue yourself with fire, increasing your speed and burning all enemies that get too close.[/i][/p][p] [/p][p]When the swarm is on you, or you need to push through the thick of it, Wild Fire may keep you safe. Wild Fire becomes even more powerful with its Augments, capable of incinerating anything that stands in your way.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/9e20fbaf216199c5fc602ca5e07b52f8a7b67825.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Major Augments[/b][/p][p] [/p][p][b]Fireball! [/b]While Wild Fire is active, fire balls will launch along with your attacks.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Firestorm: [/b]On activation, deploy a fire tornado that pulls in and immolates enemies.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Free Radical: [/b]While Wild Fire is active, the effects of the attack occasionally drop pools of fire on the ground.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Flashover: [/b]Starting with the initial activation, every third Wild Fire pulse deals significantly more damage in a larger radius.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Minor Augments[/b][/p][p] [/p][p][b]Oxidizer: [/b]Increase Wild Fire’s duration.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Backdraft: [/b]On activation, nearby zombies are knocked down, and larger enemies are stunned.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Molten Core: [/b]Enemies are dealt more damage the closer they get to you.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Heat Surge: [/b]While Wild Fire is active, your movement speed is increased even further.[/p][p][/p][h2][u]Call of Duty: Warzone Season 03 Reloaded Content[/u][/h2][p][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][td][p][/p][h2]CALL OF DUTY: WARZONE SUMMARY[/h2][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]New Limited-Time Modes:[/b] Engage in a high-speed chase of Police vs. Thieves in Hot Pursuit, a new limited-time mode testing your driving skills throughout Avalon. In Prop Hunt Royale, the party mode arrives as 24v24 on Rebirth Island, featuring over a dozen prop types to help players blend in with the environment.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Power Up with Spikes: [/b]Check your local Buy Station for the introduction of Spikes, an experimental military stimulant granting Operators improved combat capabilities including Armor Salvaging, Prone Firing, and Handicraft.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Lethal Addition:[/b] The Cluster Grenade arrives in the Mid-Season across Core Battle Royale and Resurgence modes, the ideal weapon for scattering and blasting enemy squads.[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][h3]New Limited-Time Modes[/h3][p] [/p][p][b]Hot Pursuit[/b][/p][p][i]Avalon, 100 players, Black Ops Royale[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ec203bedc1e43d83f87ee4f5ec0f4690b4a21db5.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Drop into a high intensity squad mode where Police hunt down Thieves in a fast-paced, vehicle-driven game mode that will test your driving skills and see just how well you really know the streets of Avalon. To keep the action moving, Hot Pursuit features an increased vehicle spawn rate across the map, and with Resurgence rules in place, Operators will respawn up to a certain point as long as one squad member remains alive.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Police[/b][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p]Police vehicles include the ATV, JLTV, and the Light Heli. Activate the sirens on these vehicles to initiate a radar pulse, showing nearby Thieves on the mini-map.
